ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: /admin/scoring route was NOT registered in App.js — ScoringAdmin was imported but no <Route path='scoring'> under /admin. Direct URL /admin/scoring or clicking admin-nav-scoring redirected to '/' via the catch-all Navigate. Added the missing route; all subsequent scoring flows work end-to-end.

Direct URL load (or hard refresh) of /teams/martin redirects to /teams because TeamDetail checks `if (!team) return <Navigate to='/teams' replace />` on first render BEFORE useLiveData resolves. The mock TEAMS fallback uses colorKey-based ids ('green','gold','white','black') which never match the real ids ('martin','white','foret',...), so the Navigate fires immediately. Navigating via <Link> from /teams works because React Query cache is already warm. Recommend: wait for `useLiveData` result (or use a loading state) before redirecting, e.g. `if (live !== null && !team) return <Navigate .../>` or show a loading skeleton while live===null.

action_items: Verify the App.js Route fix I applied (added `<Route path='scoring' element={<ScoringAdmin />} />` under /admin) — the entire /admin/scoring feature was unreachable via URL/nav prior to this fix.

Fix TeamDetail race condition: don't Navigate('/teams') while `useLiveData('teams')` is still null; wait for live to resolve or show a loading state. Currently a direct-URL user hitting /teams/{id} bounces to the teams list.

(Optional UX) In ScoringAdmin, when selecting a team via score-team-*, consider resetting current hole to 1 (or first-unscored) instead of retaining the previously-viewed hole — during testing, switching from martin→white→foret carried the current hole forward and caused misaligned score entry across teams. Not blocking, but a common tournament-day footgun.

TeamDetail.jsx race condition (see ui_bugs #2) — same pattern likely affects any detail page that depends on live data with a mock fallback that has different ids than the API.
